comments: Gate 2 approved. All nine scenarios of TP-ETA-411-001 v1 are approved for BDD_DESIGN. This decision was given by the reviewer in chat and transcribed into this artifact by the orchestrator; the transcription is a record of a human decision, not an agent approval. Two questions were put to the reviewer in the review package and are answered by this blanket approval, so they are recorded here rather than left to inference. First: TS-ETA-411-008 and TS-ETA-411-009 may proceed even though their destinations were never navigated and the expectation derives from a link address. The approval authorises writing them; it does not make them observed. PLAYWRIGHT_VALIDATION must walk both links, and if either resolves elsewhere the correct response is to return here, not to quietly rewrite the expectation. Second: the routing asymmetry is accepted for release 1.0 - New Transaction and Workspace each have two planned routes and Preferences has one. AMB-ETA-411-006 remains REVIEW_REQUIRED and this approval does not resolve it; no agent may add a header Preferences scenario while it is open. Three limitations carried in from Gate 1 stay in force and are not cured by this approval: TS-ETA-411-004 and TS-ETA-411-005 assert a landing address only and will pass on a page that reached the right address and then failed to render, TS-ETA-411-002 rests on a single observed account, and the plan contains no negative scenarios because the story states no failure behaviour. The suite proves navigation works and proves nothing about how it fails. Adding failure coverage requires a new acceptance criterion approved at Gate 1, not a scenario invented at BDD_DESIGN.

itemDecisions.comment: Successful organization sign-in lands on the Home page. AC-ETA-411-001. Ends at arrival and asserts nothing about Home page content.

Home page presents three activatable icons. AC-ETA-411-002. Approved on the AMB-ETA-411-003 resolution that the icon set does not vary by user; that resolution is the reviewer's assertion, observed with one account only.
New Transaction icon reaches the New Transaction page. AC-ETA-411-003. The strongest scenario in the plan: asserts both the landing address and a unique Create Transaction heading.
Workspace icon reaches the Workspace page. AC-ETA-411-004. Address-only assertion per the AMB-ETA-411-002 resolution; no unique on-screen element exists and every page returns the same browser title.
Preferences icon reaches the Preferences page. AC-ETA-411-005. Address-only assertion, and the only approved route to this page while AMB-ETA-411-006 is open.

Command Center control returns the user Home. AC-ETA-411-006. Walks all three return legs rather than inferring two from one. Asserts the outcome only, never how the control is labelled - the control has no accessible name.
Header navigation offers New Transaction and Workspace links. AC-ETA-411-007. Two links, not three. No header Preferences link exists and none may be invented.

Header New Transaction link reaches the New Transaction page. AC-ETA-411-008. Approved as an expectation to be verified, not as an observation. Destination taken from the link address and never navigated - see RISK-TP-ETA-411-001.

Header Workspace link reaches the Workspace page. AC-ETA-411-009. Approved as an expectation to be verified, not as an observation. Destination taken from the link address and never navigated - see RISK-TP-ETA-411-001.
